data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 七里滨的潮声花嫁
data.description: 【七里滨海边小礼堂·黄昏】翔子穿着柔和的白色婚纱站在敞开的礼堂门口，黑发被海风吹过肩头；她双手捧着白色小花，侧头听了一会潮声，再向镜头露出让人安心的温柔笑容。
data.action: 海边礼堂门口听潮声后捧花转身，露出让人安心的温柔笑
data.lighting: peach sunset and reflected ocean light
data.mood: 在海潮旁兑现的温柔承诺
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara from Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai wears a soft white bridal dress with a sea-blue sash, short veil and a bouquet of white coastal flowers. She stands in the open chapel doorway with a small coastal bouquet held close to her heart. She listens to the waves before turning toward the viewer, the sea-blue sash and gentle smile carrying a calm promise through the evening wind. peach sunset and reflected ocean light.
